Title: General Availability: Azure Red Hat OpenShift support for OpenShift 4.6

Body.Content:
Azure Red Hat OpenShift support for OpenShift 4.6 is now generally available. Red Hat OpenShift release 4.6 includes deeper integration with OperatorHub, improvements to Red Hat CoreOS, and more.

Learn more about OpenShift 4.6.

Learn more about the Azure Red Hat OpenShift release schedule.
